description: This file contains unit tests for the PaletteGenerator class, verifying default value generation, value ranges, color uniqueness, and repeated calls.

classes.name: PaletteGeneratorTest
classes.description: Test suite for PaletteGenerator class, verifying palette generation correctness.

methods.name: generates exactly 5 colors by default
methods.description: Tests that the generatePalette function returns exactly 5 colors when called without parameters.

methods.name: all colors are within valid HSL ranges
methods.description: Ensures that each color in the palette has hue, saturation, and lightness values within correct ranges.

methods.name: colors are visually distinct
methods.description: Checks that generated colors produce unique hex color codes, indicating visual distinctness.

methods.name: rapid consecutive generation succeeds
methods.description: Verifies that multiple rapid calls to generatePalette do not cause failures and consistently produce correct-sized palettes.
